values.note: 2026 rates (non-resident; township residents pay $5 less): standard sites $28, lake sites $33, lake sites 65-70 $43. Site 33B (24 ft) $23 and sites 72-76 (12-14 ft) $18; tent sites $23. Monthly $840 (non-lake) / $990 (eligible lake sites). Coin-op showers; dump $5 for non-campers, on-site pump-out $25 (the amenities page says $20).

fees.source: https://ontonagontownshippark.com/rates-and-rules ('2026 campground rates', 'All other sites $28/night $23/night for township residents', 'All other lake sites $33/night', 'Lake sites 65 - 70 $43/night') + https://ontonagontownshippark.com/map-%26-site-descriptions (per-site lengths and rates), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Site pages list sites 1-76 plus 33B, most 40-45 ft; sites 72-76 are only 12-14 ft and 33B and 71 are 24 ft. Three tent-only sites (T1-T3) besides.

facilities.source: https://ontonagontownshippark.com/amenities ('Our modern shower and bathroom facility', 'Showers are all coin operated', 'a self-service sanitation station'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'We do not accept reservations for campsites.' Call the park office on the day of arrival and it will hold an available site until 8 p.m. that day only; sites are assigned at the office first come, first served, with a daily 11:30 a.m. upgrade list for lake sites. Lake sites are time-limited June 1 through Labor Day (9 consecutive nights; sites 65-70, 16). Check-in 1 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. Eastern.

booking.source: https://ontonagontownshippark.com/rates-and-rules ('We do not accept reservations for campsites', rules 4-8, '9-day consecutive max stay', '16-day consecutive max stay'), read 2026-10-22

note: Ontonagon Township park on the Lake Superior shore at the mouth of the Ontonagon River, 972 Lakeshore Dr (local government; RV Life mislabels as commercial). Newer premium sites on the beach, a more social main section, and secluded wooded sites across the road; sandy beach, playground, disc golf. --Claude
summary: Township park's own site confirms 2026 rates $28 standard to $43 (lake sites 65-70; township residents $5 less), no reservations (same-day hold only, FCFS), electricity and water at every site, coin-op showers, flush toilets, dump; site pages give 77 numbered sites to 45 ft (count 80->77, max rig 45 added). Season dates not posted ('closed for the season'). Electric amperage (50, from note prose) is not stated, left. Note cleaned of the price, booking, site and amenity text the fields hold. Phone (906) 884-2930 matches.
